results.name: Separate login page per role

results.actual: "Email or password is incorrect."

results.input: shruti@student… on /login/faculty
results.expected: Error: use the login page for your role
results.actual: "This account is not a Faculty/Admin account. Use the login page for your role."

results.name: Each role lands on its own dashboard
results.input: Log in as student, Dance manager, admin
results.expected: /dashboard, /manage, /faculty
results.actual: #/dashboard, #/manage, #/faculty

results.actual:
C

results.name: Logged-out visitor is sent to login for a dashboard
results.input: Log out, open /dashboard
results.expected: Redirect to /login/student?next=…
results.actual: #/login/student?next=%2Fdashboard

results.name: Sign up as a new student, log out, log in again
results.input: Sign up "Neha Rao" neha@atria.edu.in / campus2026; log out; log in on /login/student
results.expected: Lands on dashboard after sign-up and again after the later login
results.actual: After sign-up: #/dashboard "Hi, Neha"; after logging out and back in: #/dashboard "Hi, Neha"

results.name: Sign-up form rejects bad input
results.input: Existing email, short password, mismatched confirm, a @gmail.com address
results.expected: Field errors (incl. "must end with @atria.edu.in"), no account created
results.actual: Browser check: su-password: Use at least 8 characters with letters and numbers; su-confirm: Passwords do not match · gmail address: "Use your Atria email ending in @atria.edu.in" · Server check: "An account with this email already exists. Log in instead."

results.name: Club Manager sign-up waits for the faculty head’s approval
results.input: Sign up "Kabir" as Dance Club manager; try to log in; Dance head approves in Users; log in again
results.expected: Pending message, login refused, then works after approval
results.actual: "Request sent … waiting for approval"; login refused ("Your account is waiting for approval by a faculty member."); Music head sees no Approve button; Dance head approved → Kabir lands on "Dance Club"

results.name: Passwords never reach the browser
results.input: Faculty loads /api/state (all users)
results.expected: No password or hash in the response
results.actual: State has 1 users, no password fields or hashes

results.name: Student sees all events and all clubs
results.input: Student opens /events and /clubs
results.expected: 13 upcoming events, 6 clubs, both rule messages shown
results.actual: 13 events, 6 clubs; rules: "You can join a maximum of 2 clubs." + "You can attend/register for events from any club."

results.name: Register for another club’s event without being a member
results.input: Shruti (no clubs) registers for Open Mic Evening (Music Club)
results.expected: Registered; dashboard shows Confirmed
results.actual: Card: "Your registration: Confirmed / Registered"; dashboard lists Open Mic Evening · Confirmed

results.name: Joining a club sends a request
results.input: Shruti clicks "Request to join" on Dance Club, then Music Club
results.expected: Buttons turn "Requested"; toast says the manager will review; dashboard shows "Waiting for approval"
results.actual: Button "Request to join" → "Requested"; toast "Request sent to Dance Club. The club manager will review it."; member count still 128 until approved; dashboard lists 2 requests "Waiting for approval"

results.name: Join max 2 clubs (requests count)
results.input: With 2 pending requests, look at Sports Club
results.expected: Third join blocked: "Limit reached", counter 2 of 2
results.actual: Sports Club button "Limit reached" (disabled); banner "You're using 2 of 2"; 2 requests stored

results.name: Still able to register for a non-member club’s event at the limit
results.input: With 2 club slots used, register for Football Cup (Sports Club)
results.expected: Registration succeeds
results.actual: Confirmed

results.name: Withdrawing a request frees a slot
results.input: Click "Requested" on Music Club → Withdraw request, then look at Sports
results.expected: Sports "Request to join" enabled again
results.actual: Sports button: "Request to join"

results.name: Club Manager approves join requests and sees the member
results.input: Dance manager opens Manage club → Join requests → Approve Shruti; Music manager does the same
results.expected: Shruti moves to Members; count 128 → 129; Music manager cannot touch Dance requests
results.actual: Dance join requests: stu-shruti; after Approve: Members include Shruti, count 129; Music manager changing a Dance request → HTTP 403; Music manager approved Shruti for Music

results.name: Student dashboard shows everything
results.input: Shruti opens /dashboard after both approvals
results.expected: Registrations, clubs 2/2, announcements from both clubs, suggestions
results.actual: Sections: registrations, upcoming for you, My clubs (2/2) with both approved, announcements (university + Dance + Music), following

results.name: The club’s faculty head manages its members too
results.input: Raju requests Dance; Dance faculty head approves on My club → View, then removes him (confirm)
results.expected: Head sees request + member list, can approve and remove; Raju ends with no clubs
results.actual: Dance head saw request from Raju, approved (members: stu-shruti, stu-raju), removed him (members: stu-shruti); Music Club's member page blocked for the Dance head

results.name: Registration needing approval starts Pending
results.input: Shruti requests Battle of Bands (requiresApproval)
results.expected: Status "Pending approval"
results.actual: Pending approval

results.name: Club Manager accepts a registration
results.input: Music manager → Battle of Bands registrations → Accept
results.expected: Student then sees Confirmed
results.actual: Manager saw "Shruti Kushwaha · Pending approval", clicked Accept → Confirmed; student dashboard shows Battle of Bands · Confirmed

results.name: Club Manager rejects a registration and the seat is freed
results.input: Raju registers Open Mic; Music manager rejects
results.expected: Raju sees Rejected; seats filled goes back down
results.actual: Seats filled 50/60 → 49/60; Raju sees "Rejected"

results.name: Club Manager sees only their own club
results.input: Dance manager opens /manage
results.expected: Only Dance Club events, members, announcements
results.actual: club=dance-club; events=annual-dance-fest, dance-workshop; members list includes Shruti Kushwaha

results.name: Club Manager blocked from another club’s management data
results.input: Dance manager types Music URLs + /faculty
results.expected: All three show "Not available"
results.actual: Music registrations, Music edit URL and /faculty/clubs all blocked

results.name: Club Manager sees only "Manage club" and "Events"
results.input: Log in as Music Club manager; check navbar, /, /clubs, /units, /events, a Dance event URL
results.expected: Nav = Manage club + Events; other pages redirect to /manage; Events = student-style page with only Music events + Music announcements
results.actual: Nav: "Manage club" + "Events"; #/→#/manage, #/clubs→#/manage, #/units→#/manage; Events page = student UI (search, category chips, date filter, cards) titled "Events", scoped "Events hosted by Music Club"; cards=open-mic-evening, battle-of-bands; announcements = Music only; Dance event URL blocked

results.name: Invalid event form creates nothing
results.input: Dance manager: seats 0 + past date
results.expected: Errors shown, event not created
results.actual: date: Date cannot be in the past; seats: Seats must be at least 1

results.name: Club Manager creates an event
results.input: Dance manager: "Salsa Social Night", valid data
results.expected: Appears on /events hosted by Dance Club
results.actual: Host field: "Dance Club (locked)"; listed in the manager's Events section and on the student /events page "by Dance Club"

results.name: Club Manager posts an announcement; members see it
results.input: Dance manager posts "Costume fitting"
results.expected: Shown in the manager's Events section; Shruti (Dance member) sees it on her dashboard
results.actual: Audience "Dance Club members (locked)"; student dashboard shows "Costume fitting"

results.name: Cancelled event shows on the student dashboard
results.input: Shruti registers Annual Dance Fest; Dance manager cancels it (confirm)
results.expected: Dashboard: "Cancelled by organiser"; event page blocks registering
results.actual: Dashboard row: "Annual Dance Fest … Cancelled by organiser"; other student sees "Cancelled" (disabled)

results.name: Faculty/Admin dashboard
results.input: Admin opens /faculty
results.expected: Stats + links to Clubs, Events, Users, Announcements
results.actual: Stats tiles + 4 management areas shown

results.actual: Navbar: Admin, My club, Events, Clubs, Users; Events rows: annual-dance-fest, film-screening, maker-tools-workshop, dance-workshop, ai-ethics-talk, career-fair, salsa-social-night-3sga; Dance Workshop venue → Studio B (student sees it); unit event editable; Music event edit blocked
